rowText: Name-first boss question. Portal 2 running, Strategy, masking on, streaming on. Ask 'wheatley fight'. Pass when Wheatley's tactics are plain text from the first streamed word with no mid-stream chip. Compare with 'how do I beat wheatley'. Then reopen the chat from the slot list: still plain.

setup.question: wheatley fight
setup.note: Portal 2 was confirmed installed and in Steam's own library tonight, resolving the 2026-09-15 vs SSH disagreement noted in the plan -- the SSH read was the correct one; Portal 2 launched normally.

steps.action: Pinned 'wheatley fight' as a chip, selected it, sent it.
steps.observed: Reply streamed and finished (43.1s). No masked/spoiler chip appeared at any point; the whole answer, including specific boss tactics (bomb throws, portal placement, corrupted cores), rendered as plain text from the start. A 'Wheatley -- From the Portal wiki' card attached below the reply.

steps.action: Closed and reopened the whole plugin panel, then re-read the same chat.
steps.observed: The reply still reads as plain text, no box -- unchanged after the reopen.

verdictSentence: Naming the boss up front worked as intended: the fight advice came back as plain, readable text right away, with no hidden or blurred box, and stayed that way after closing and reopening the chat.
notes: The comparison ask ('how do I beat wheatley') was pinned and ready, but a separate, already-known problem (walking down into a finished reply loses the highlighted control partway through, filed 2026-09-18 09:45 in tonight's progress log) stopped the D-pad from reaching that second chip in time; only the first phrasing was confirmed. The row's main pass condition (plain text, no mid-stream chip, still plain after reopening) is fully met on the phrasing that was tested.
